sources.title: 黄舒骏：现在的流行音乐叫流量音乐更合适_手机新浪网
sources.description:
Portrait of Huang Shujun

Huang Shujun appears in a crisp black suit and tie, standing against a plain gray background. His composed expression and relaxed posture reflect the confidence of a seasoned artist.

The accompanying interview explores his three-decade career, from his 1988 debut album to his groundbreaking role as EMI’s music director producing dozens of records each year. It also covers his surprise at seeing his songs transformed into the jukebox musical “Restless Sorrow,” and his view that modern pop has shifted into “traffic music.”

sources.description:
Huang Shujun’s "两岸" Album Cover

The album cover features a warm, golden-hued close-up of Taiwanese singer-songwriter Huang Shujun. He rests his chin on his hand, looking thoughtfully into the distance. Beside him, the Chinese title "两岸" and his name "黄舒骏" are prominently displayed in stylized characters.

This portrait captures an introspective mood, with soft shadows accentuating his facial features and tousled hair. The minimalist design focuses attention on Huang Shujun’s expression, reflecting the personal and reflective nature of the album.

sources.title: 不變 - 黃舒駿  - 為你瘋狂專輯 - LINE MUSIC
sources.description:
黃舒駿《為你瘋狂》專輯封面

黃舒駿身著紫色襯衫，倚靠在斑駁的牆面前，手捧一束白粉相間的花朵，神情溫柔而深情。畫面左上方以紅色筆觸書寫「為你瘋狂」，左下方則是紫色字體的「黃舒駿」，整體色調柔和且富有浪漫氛圍。

這張封面對應專輯中的主打歌曲「不變」，歌詞由黃舒駿一人作詞作曲，描述長久思念、無法割捨的情感，以及對愛人不變的牽掛與祝福。封面與歌詞共同傳達出深情不渝的主題，突顯黃舒駿細膩的音樂風格。
